page_title: NEW 2-2 TOT | Newcastle v Tottenham Hotspur 02/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+10' Aaron Ramsdale leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Pedro Porro (Tottenham).
90+9' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough foul. Thomas Bramall stops the game and makes a call.
90+7' Corner kicks – 11:7.
90+5' 2 - 2 GOAL! Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) gets to the rebound inside the box and fires in a stunning overhead kick. Phenomenal finish! 2:2.
90+4' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) takes the corner but it's cleared.

90+4' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+3' That's the end of the game for Lewis Miley, who is replaced by Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd).
90+2' The corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is hurriedly cleared.
90+1' Some neat passing and movement from Tottenham as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
87' Thomas Frank has decided to substitute Mohammed Kudus and he is replaced by Wilson Odobert (Tottenham).
87' Substitution. Pape Matar Sarr is replaced by Archie Gray (Tottenham).
86' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Guglielmo Vicario no chance!
86' Richarlison (Tottenham) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
85' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
85' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
83' There's a break in play and referee Thomas Bramall must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Newcastle using VAR. This could be interesting!
83' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Newcastle for a penalty. Play continues.
82' Newcastle have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
81' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Newcastle get a corner.

78' 1 - 1 Goal! Mohammed Kudus hands Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
78' The resulting corner from Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
77' Here comes a substitution. Lucas Bergvall is given a rest as he is replaced by Xavi Simons (Tottenham).
77' Here is a change. Randal Kolo Muani is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Richarlison (Tottenham).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Brennan Johnson leaves the pitch and Mathys Tel (Tottenham) comes on.

77' Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Tottenham.

76' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to keep the ball from hitting the net.
75' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) whips in a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario is well positioned and punches the ball away.

75' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

71' Goal! Nick Woltemade puts Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
70' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is flagged for offside.
69' The resulting corner from Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) is cleared.
69' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Newcastle.
66' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) replaces Harvey Barnes.
66' It is time for a substitution. Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) is on for Jacob Murphy.
66' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) sends the corner into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario intercepts it and averts the threat.
65' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Newcastle win a corner.
64' A dangerous looking corner kick from Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) is cleared to safety by the defence.
63' The corner kick from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Tottenham manage to earn a corner.

63' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
60' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
59' Total attempts – 13:4.
56' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
55' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

55' Bruno Guimaraes launches a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) is alert to thwart the effort. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
55' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Newcastle.
54' The resulting set piece from Newcastle is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

54' A lofted pass picks out Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Newcastle will have a corner.
53' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) takes the free kick which is inaccurate and the defence has no problem with the clearance.

52' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Thomas Bramall has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Newcastle.
50' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
48' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the left post is smartly dealt with by Guglielmo Vicario.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Eddie Howe gives a chance to Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) and Sandro Tonali is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' The game is interrupted as Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) is flagged offside.
43' Newcastle are seeing far more of the ball now.

40' A long cross into the box finds Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) unmarked, but his header from the edge of the six-yard box is wild and goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.

37' Mohammed Kudus slides a brilliant pass into Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
35' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky!
34' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario comes off his line to gather the ball.
30' The resulting corner from Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is cleared by the defence.
30' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Newcastle force a corner. They send men into the box.
27' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
26' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 62:38.
23' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
20' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
20' A cross, provided by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd), caused no threat to the opposition's defence as the ball was cleared out of danger. Newcastle will take a corner kick.
19' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Newcastle in a dangerous position.

18' Guglielmo Vicario makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) on the edge of the box and he drills goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the goal.
15' Great teamplay by Newcastle as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
12' The corner from Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) is intercepted by the defence.
11' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Tottenham comes to nothing. Good work from Tottenham as they win a corner.

11' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him. Tottenham have a corner.
10' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.
9' An attempted cross from Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner.
8' Thomas Bramall couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) and blew his whistle.
6' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

5' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Newcastle.
4' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
3' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
1' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
1' The match has just started.
Tottenham will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Thomas Bramall.
